# Icons

Longhand's icons are Apple's SF Symbols, with one exception.

| Icon | Source | Licence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GitHub mark (`GitHubMark` in `Support/Theme.swift`) | Octicons, `mark-github-16`: https://github.com/primer/octicons | MIT |

The mark is GitHub's logo and is used only on controls that lead to GitHub, unaltered, as
GitHub's logo guidelines allow (https://github.com/logos).
